text: used for the treatment and prophylaxis of candidiasis and also in the treat- ment of aspergillosis. It is given as the sodium salt by intravenous infusion in doses of 50 mg once daily for candidiasis. For the treatment of oesophageal candidiasis the recommended dose is 150 mg daily. For aspergillosis 50 to 150 mg is given once daily. Doses up to 300 mg daily have been used in severe or refractory disease. A dose of 50 mg daily is used for prophylaxis of candi- diasis in patients undergoing haematopoietic stem cell transplan- tation. ◊ Reviews. 1. Denning DW. Echinocandin antifungal drugs.
